description: Add Vercel and Cloudflare Pages deployment configuration, plus a comprehensive root README.md with deploy buttons and project documentation
steps: Create `apps/web/vercel.json` with buildCommand: 'bun run build', outputDirectory: 'dist', framework: 'vite', and rewrites for SPA routing (all paths to /index.html)
Create `apps/web/wrangler.toml` with name 'hijistream', compatibility_date '2024-01-01', and [site] bucket='./dist' for Cloudflare Pages static site deployment

Create a comprehensive root `README.md` at `/projects/sandbox/HIJISTREAM/README.md` containing: project title and description (HIJISTREAM - streaming platform), Deploy to Vercel button ([![Deploy with Vercel](https://vercel.com/button)](https://vercel.com/new/clone?repository-url=https://github.com/user/HIJISTREAM&root-directory=apps/web)), Deploy to Cloudflare Pages instructions (step-by-step with wrangler), Tech Stack section (React 18, Vite 5, Tailwind CSS, React Query, React Router, Bun), Project Structure section showing monorepo layout, Features list (Movies browsing, TV shows, Search, Watch Progress, Responsive design), Local Development instructions using Bun (bun install, bun run dev, bun run build, bun run test)
acceptance_criteria: apps/web/vercel.json exists with valid JSON and correct Vite SPA configuration
apps/web/wrangler.toml exists with correct Cloudflare Pages config
README.md at project root exists with Deploy to Vercel badge/button, Cloudflare deploy instructions, tech stack, project structure, and development setup instructions
bun run build still succeeds after changes
verification: Run `bun run build` in apps/web/ to confirm build still works
Run `cat apps/web/vercel.json` and verify valid JSON
Run `cat apps/web/wrangler.toml` and verify valid TOML
Verify README.md exists at project root with deploy buttons
findings: All three files created successfully. Build passes without issues. Bun is used throughout (not npm/yarn) as per project conventions.
